name: AcidTouch
description: New KAOCID. Tap to roll a TB-3PO-style 303 phrase; XY plays cutoff and resonance. The previous Kaocid unit is unchanged. Audio in is replaced.

params.name: CUT
params.detail: Filter cutoff, about 80 Hz to 8 kHz

params.name: TIME
params.detail: Step length around a synced 1/16 (host BPM)

params.name: OCT
params.detail: Phrase range, 1 to 3 octaves above Root

params.name: ROOT
params.detail: Phrase root, C1 to C3, natural minor. Default C2

params.name: MODE
params.detail: Saw or square, and Gate, Latch, Thru, or Mutate
